eventName.description: Name of the event as listed by the source.

date.description: Event date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Time of day is not captured — sources report it too inconsistently to be reliable.

venue.description: Venue hosting the event. For heuristically-parsed club sites this falls back to the venue whose site was crawled.

address.description: Street address of the venue, when the source provides one. Often empty — many sources list only a venue name.

city.description: City of the venue. Falls back to the searched city when the source doesn't state one.

lat.description: Latitude of the venue, either from the source directly (Google Maps, Facebook) or from geocoding its name/address.

lon.description: Longitude of the venue, either from the source directly (Google Maps, Facebook) or from geocoding its name/address.

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the searched city center to the venue, in kilometers, rounded to one decimal place.

genres.description: Genres matched for this event. Specific genres come from keyword matching or a source's own genre tag; the generic "electronic" tag means the event is electronic/DJ music but names no specific genre.

sourceName.description: Which source this event was found on — an aggregator name, a club/venue name, or "Facebook Events".

sourceUrl.description: Link back to the event on its source, for verifying details the extraction may have missed.

description.description: Event description, when the source provides one. Empty for heuristically-parsed listings, which yield only a title and date.
description.example: This is an example event description.

confidence.description: How reliable this event's data is expected to be, inherited from its source: "high" for curated electronic-only sources, down to "low" for mixed-programming venues and heuristic matches.
